about: Search test: each question names the passages that must reach the writer. A target is a source, and optionally its locator (exact, or the start of it: 'section 66E' matches 'section 66E (inserted ...)') and text it must contain (any of the strings, case and spacing ignored). Every target is checked to exist in the corpus before it is scored. Some questions are worded in everyday words on purpose: search has to bridge them to the source's words.

questions.q: What does Article 21 of the Constitution protect?
What must the President be satisfied of before proclaiming a national emergency?
Which BNS section covers defamation, and what is the penalty?
What is the punishment for murder under the new criminal code?

targets.has: whoever commits murder shall be punished with death
